# Adaptive Layout

Adaptive Layout switches among one, two, and three pane modes from container size, detail state, and text scale.

## Composition

Compose public components and contracts; see [Adaptive Layout](/en/components/app-layout).

## States

Cover loading, empty, error, offline, permission, and recovery. Focus enters the new task heading after pane transitions.

## Responsive

Wide screens preserve context; compact widths use a drawer, sheet, overlay, or route.
